title: Add Group to Section adds every member of a workspace group to a sidebar section once, refuses a second add and an unknown section, and groups have no Show Group in Finder (cx-a9h6)
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab; the sidebar layout document is loaded (SidebarDocWiring)
converted from scripts/cmux-next/workspace-group-section-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-097.json links them

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/workspace-group-section-e2e.py (kept): a two-workspace group, a titled section, then the action as the palette runs it, by the section's title

the group's first member (created/0, its public ws_ id); a socket run without focus files it in the window without showing it, so no waitable facet changes and the settle through the reply's sequence is the wait
the first member alone in a new group
the second member: a workspace made below a grouped one joins its group
a list section in the top region, titled so the action can name it (the script adds a time to the title because it reuses a running app; the case's launch is fresh)

script row 'Add Group to Section adds every member to the section': the group is the target workspace's (AppActionContext.personalGroup), the section is named by its title as the CLI may; on 32c2b6a7e76 (the parent of 52d2b46c5df) there is no such action, so the run answers control.not_found
script row 'Adding it again is refused, not duplicated': every member is in the section already (RefusalStrings.groupAlreadyInSection), a typed refusal
script row 'An unknown section is refused' (SidebarSectionStrings.noSuchSection)
script row 'Groups have no Show Group in Finder': an unknown action (4265e78e755 removed it; on its parent 0907736c408 it ran)

invariants: at grouped the topology lists one workspace group holding first's and second's workspaces
add-again, unknown-section and no-reveal-in-finder change nothing: end's topology and intents equal added's
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the section's workspace items (the script reads debug.sidebar_rows items by section_title): the sidebar facet has no provider in the base build (p15-oracle-036), so the case sees the add through its outcomes (ok once, then refused as already there) and not through the items
the one undo step the add makes: no undo step is run
